report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-20 starting at approximately 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC), mf-order-service experienced an elevated error rate of ~6.3%, failing mutual fund SIP orders with HTTP 500. The on-call SRE initially ruled out a deployment of mf-order-service because legacy-jenkins-mum recorded the deployment timestamp (09:20) without timezone metadata, leading the change indexing system and SRE to misinterpret it as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST). In reality, deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) occurred at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introducing nominee validation for SIP orders. The new validator threw an unhandled NullPointerException whenever a folio lacked a nominee record.
report.rootCauseStatement: Deployment CHG-48219 (version 4.1.0) of mf-order-service deployed at 03:50 UTC introduced a regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee that throws an unhandled NullPointerException when processing folios lacking nominee records, causing ~6.3% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.1.0) of mf-order-service introduced a code regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee that raises an unhandled NullPointerException for folios lacking nominee records, causing ~6% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.
hypotheses.rationale: Deployment CHG-48219 ('nominee validation for SIP orders') occurred at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC). Within 2 minutes (03:52:07 UTC), HTTP 500 errors began appearing on v4.1.0 with NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee, accounting for 1,293 order failures and directly explaining the ~6% error rate.

hypotheses.cause: A data pipeline or upstream sync failure resulted in missing nominee records for approximately 6% of user folios, triggering pre-order validation failure in mf-order-service.
hypotheses.rationale: Missing nominee records on existing/legacy folios are standard and permissible under certain conditions, but the new validator code released in v4.1.0 failed to handle null nominee records gracefully.

facts.statement: Deployment CHG-48219 for mf-order-service (version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0, 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders') was executed via legacy-jenkins-mum with timestamp '2026-10-20T09:20:00.000' and tz: 'none'.
The error_rate for mf-order-service jumped from a baseline of ~0.3% to 1.51% at 03:50 UTC and 6.32% at 03:55 UTC, staying at ~6.3% across the entire window through 10:15 UTC.

mf-order-service logged 1,293 instances of 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' with status 500 and version 4.1.0 starting at 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z.
mf-order-service p95 latency remained flat and stable between 370 ms and 424 ms throughout the window.

mandate-service and bank-connector exhibited normal baseline error rates (~1.02% and ~0.49%), normal p95 latencies (~1772 ms and ~1970 ms), and normal mandate success rates (~96.8%) with no error logs around the incident onset.

The shared relational database showed normal lock wait times (~3.9 ms), active connection counts (~171), CPU utilization (~35.6%), and slow queries (~2.6/min), with no deadlock or pool exhaustion errors.

inferences.statement: legacy-jenkins-mum logged timestamps in Mumbai local time (IST, UTC+05:30) without explicit timezone offsets, causing the change store and on-call SRE to misinterpret 09:20 IST as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST) and mistakenly rule out CHG-48219.

The NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee was directly introduced by the newly added nominee validation code in v4.1.0, crashing on folios that have null nominee records instead of handling missing records cleanly.
Upstream bank connections, mandate verification services, RTA communications, and database saturation did not cause the SIP order failure spike.

assumptions.statement: Folios without nominee records represent valid legacy folios or permissible nominee opt-outs rather than data corruption.

timeline.event: Deployment CHG-48219 completes, upgrading mf-order-service from v4.0.7 to v4.1.0 to add nominee validation for SIP orders.
mf-order-service error_rate surges from ~0.29% baseline to 1.51% at 03:50 UTC and 6.32% at 03:55 UTC.
First HTTP 500 error logged in mf-order-service v4.1.0 due to NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee.
Incident INC-9077 reported by on-call SRE, who erroneously dismissed the deployment due to timezone confusion in the deploy log.

confidence.rationale: The deployment timestamp (03:50 UTC) matches the exact moment error rates surged, and application logs definitively show 1,293 instances of NullPointerException inside the newly deployed FolioValidator.validateNominee running on v4.1.0.

gaps.description: Source code diff of FolioValidator.validateNominee in build-60433 could not be inspected due to tool budget limits.
gaps.impact: Minimal impact; error log messages and deployment release summaries explicitly confirm that validateNominee threw NullPointerException when nominee records were absent.

recommendedActions.action: Roll back mf-order-service to v4.0.7 immediately, or release a hotfix to FolioValidator.validateNominee adding null safety for folios without nominee records.
recommendedActions.rationale: Eliminates the NullPointerException causing ~6.3% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.
recommendedActions.verification: Confirm that mf-order-service error_rate drops back to baseline (~0.3%) and no further NullPointerException errors appear in logs.

recommendedActions.action: Configure legacy-jenkins-mum to write deployment timestamps in ISO-8601 format with explicit UTC offsets.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents timezone ambiguity that led SREs to misinterpret 09:20 IST as 09:20 UTC and rule out relevant deployments.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect change management feed for subsequent deployments from legacy-jenkins-mum to ensure UTC timezone indicators (Z or +00:00) are present.

recommendedActions.action: Add unit and integration tests in mf-order-service for SIP validation covering folios lacking nominee records.
recommendedActions.rationale: Ensures that future validator releases gracefully handle legacy folios and optional nominee states.
recommendedActions.verification: Check CI build test suites for build-60433 successor pipelines.

incident.title: Fund order errors since morning
incident.summary: Fund orders (mostly SIPs) have been failing since about 09:22 IST, roughly 6% errors. We checked the deploy log: the mf-order-service release ran at 14:50 IST, after the errors began, so we've ruled it out. Suspect something upstream (RTA?).
incident.userImpact: Some users cannot place fund orders.

payload.question: Propose candidate causes before any evidence

candidates.cause: Degradation or timeout in upstream Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) order submission endpoint
candidates.whyPlausible: Mutual fund SIP instalment orders must be communicated to external RTAs. Partial degradation or rate limiting by a specific RTA partner could produce an isolated ~6% failure rate specifically affecting fund orders.
candidates.wouldConfirm: Outgoing API calls from mf-order-service to RTA endpoints showing elevated error rates (5xx/timeouts) starting around 03:52 UTC (09:22 IST).
candidates.wouldRuleOut: RTA response latencies and status codes are normal, or order failures occur internally before external submission is attempted.

candidates.cause: Failure in SIP mandate verification via mandate-service or partner bank connectors
candidates.whyPlausible: SIP orders require mandate-service to verify or trigger active UPI autopay or e-mandates. If a specific partner bank connector or NPCI integration degraded, approximately 6% of SIP orders tied to that bank would fail.
candidates.wouldConfirm: Error rate or latency spikes on mandate-service or bank-connector for specific banks starting around 03:52 UTC, corresponding with failed calls from mf-order-service.
candidates.wouldRuleOut: mandate-service shows normal latency and error rate, and calls from mf-order-service to mandate-service succeed across all banks.

candidates.wouldConfirm: High db_lock_wait_ms, connection pool exhaustion, or slow queries on the database starting around 03:52 UTC, accompanied by DB timeout logs in mf-order-service.
candidates.wouldRuleOut: Database active connections, lock wait time, and query latencies remain healthy throughout the incident window with no DB errors in mf-order-service.

Metrics for db_lock_wait_ms (~3.9 ms), active_connections (~171), cpu_utilization (~35.6%), and slow_queries_per_min (~2.6/min) were all stable at normal baseline levels. Database saturation and query lock contention are ruled out as the cause of the order failures.

observations.statement: The database metric db_lock_wait_ms remained completely flat and normal between 3.64 ms and 4.14 ms (mean 3.92 ms) throughout the entire window from 03:00 to 10:15 UTC, with no increase around 03:52 UTC.
The database metric active_connections remained steady between 160.0 and 181.7 connections (mean 170.7 connections), showing no connection pool exhaustion or connection spikes around 03:52 UTC.
The database cpu_utilization stayed flat between 32.77% and 38.27% (mean 35.57%) across the entire window, with no elevated CPU utilization around or after 03:52 UTC.
The database slow_queries_per_min remained at baseline levels between 0.8 and 4.4 queries/min (mean 2.61 queries/min), with no surge around 03:52 UTC.
The database request_rate remained steady between 3,349 and 4,218 queries/s (mean 3,751 queries/s) across the entire window.

Database warning and error logs recorded only 17 total entries over the 7.25-hour window (isolated slow queries of 1.4-2.5s and 3 user-canceled statements), with no deadlock errors, lock timeout errors, or connection pool errors.
The shared relational database did not experience saturation, query locking, or resource exhaustion, and is ruled out as the trigger for fund order failures starting at 03:52 UTC.

# Investigation report: Fund order errors since morning

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-20 starting at approximately 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC), mf-order-service experienced an elevated error rate of ~6.3%, failing mutual fund SIP orders with HTTP 500. The on-call SRE initially ruled out a deployment of mf-order-service because legacy-jenkins-mum recorded the deployment timestamp (09:20) without timezone metadata, leading the change indexing system and SRE to misinterpret it as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST). In reality, deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) occurred at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introducing nominee validation for SIP orders. The new validator threw an unhandled NullPointerException whenever a folio lacked a nominee record.

**Root cause:** Deployment CHG-48219 (version 4.1.0) of mf-order-service deployed at 03:50 UTC introduced a regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee that throws an unhandled NullPointerException when processing folios lacking nominee records, causing ~6.3% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.

## Hypotheses
1. **Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.1.0) of mf-order-service introduced a code regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee that raises an unhandled NullPointerException for folios lacking nominee records, causing ~6% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.** — `mf-order-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_16, ev_17, ev_20, ev_21, ev_23, ev_24] · Contradicting: none
   - Deployment CHG-48219 ('nominee validation for SIP orders') occurred at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC). Within 2 minutes (03:52:07 UTC), HTTP 500 errors began appearing on v4.1.0 with NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee, accounting for 1,293 order failures and directly explaining the ~6% error rate.
2. **A data pipeline or upstream sync failure resulted in missing nominee records for approximately 6% of user folios, triggering pre-order validation failure in mf-order-service.** — `mf-order-service`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_21, ev_23, ev_24] · Contradicting: [ev_2, ev_17]
   - Missing nominee records on existing/legacy folios are standard and permissible under certain conditions, but the new validator code released in v4.1.0 failed to handle null nominee records gracefully.

## Facts
- Deployment CHG-48219 for mf-order-service (version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0, 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders') was executed via legacy-jenkins-mum with timestamp '2026-10-20T09:20:00.000' and tz: 'none'. [ev_2, ev_17]
- The error_rate for mf-order-service jumped from a baseline of ~0.3% to 1.51% at 03:50 UTC and 6.32% at 03:55 UTC, staying at ~6.3% across the entire window through 10:15 UTC. [ev_16]
- mf-order-service logged 1,293 instances of 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' with status 500 and version 4.1.0 starting at 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z. [ev_20, ev_21, ev_23, ev_24]
- mf-order-service p95 latency remained flat and stable between 370 ms and 424 ms throughout the window. [ev_19]
- mandate-service and bank-connector exhibited normal baseline error rates (~1.02% and ~0.49%), normal p95 latencies (~1772 ms and ~1970 ms), and normal mandate success rates (~96.8%) with no error logs around the incident onset. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_9, ev_10, ev_13, ev_14]
- The shared relational database showed normal lock wait times (~3.9 ms), active connection counts (~171), CPU utilization (~35.6%), and slow queries (~2.6/min), with no deadlock or pool exhaustion errors. [ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_18, ev_22]

## Inferences
- legacy-jenkins-mum logged timestamps in Mumbai local time (IST, UTC+05:30) without explicit timezone offsets, causing the change store and on-call SRE to misinterpret 09:20 IST as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST) and mistakenly rule out CHG-48219. [ev_2, ev_17]
- The NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee was directly introduced by the newly added nominee validation code in v4.1.0, crashing on folios that have null nominee records instead of handling missing records cleanly. [ev_2, ev_17, ev_21, ev_23, ev_24]
- Upstream bank connections, mandate verification services, RTA communications, and database saturation did not cause the SIP order failure spike. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_13, ev_14, ev_18, ev_19, ev_24]

## Assumptions
- Folios without nominee records represent valid legacy folios or permissible nominee opt-outs rather than data corruption.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-20 09:20:00 IST (03:50:00 UTC)** Deployment CHG-48219 completes, upgrading mf-order-service from v4.0.7 to v4.1.0 to add nominee validation for SIP orders. [ev_2, ev_17]
- **2026-10-20 09:20:00 - 09:25:00 IST (03:50:00 - 03:55:00 UTC)** mf-order-service error_rate surges from ~0.29% baseline to 1.51% at 03:50 UTC and 6.32% at 03:55 UTC. [ev_16]
- **2026-10-20 09:22:07 IST (03:52:07 UTC)** First HTTP 500 error logged in mf-order-service v4.1.0 due to NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee. [ev_20, ev_21, ev_23]
- **2026-10-20 15:40:00 IST (10:10:00 UTC)** Incident INC-9077 reported by on-call SRE, who erroneously dismissed the deployment due to timezone confusion in the deploy log. [ev_2]

## Confidence
0.95: The deployment timestamp (03:50 UTC) matches the exact moment error rates surged, and application logs definitively show 1,293 instances of NullPointerException inside the newly deployed FolioValidator.validateNominee running on v4.1.0.

## Gaps
- Source code diff of FolioValidator.validateNominee in build-60433 could not be inspected due to tool budget limits. (impact: Minimal impact; error log messages and deployment release summaries explicitly confirm that validateNominee threw NullPointerException when nominee records were absent.)

  - Verify: Inspect change management feed for subsequent deployments from legacy-jenkins-mum to ensure UTC timezone indicators (Z or +00:00) are present.
